user.title: Kstar Inverter Connection Method
user.description: Choose whether to connect via a local USB-to-RS485 adapter or over TCP (e.g., Waveshare / Elfin RS485-to-Ethernet/Wi-Fi gateway).

serial.title: Connect via RS485 Serial
serial.description: Configure your USB-to-RS485 adapter and Modbus address. Ensure the inverter's 485 protocol is set to MODBUS (1).

tcp.title: Connect via Modbus over TCP
tcp.description: Configure your RS485-to-TCP gateway IP address and port (set gateway mode to Modbus TCP -> RTU).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Kstar inverter. Verify wiring/network, slave ID, and that the inverter protocol is set to MODBUS.
